title: WORLD NEWS BRIEF
subtitle: Global developments in humanitarian aid, public health, sport and spaceflight
footer_note: 24 NOV: UN Yemen briefing, Ituri evacuation, AFCON ruling and Shenzhou-24 crew announcement.

stories.headline: UN reports 364,000+ displaced in Yemen
stories.summary: The UN said fighting and insecurity drove displacement. In Taiz, insecurity kept about 350,000 children from a measles and rubella vaccination campaign.

stories.headline: Ebola Responders Evacuated in Ituri
stories.summary: Ebola responders evacuated from Akwe reached Bunia. Separately, nearly 6 in 10 women and girls surveyed by UNICEF reported new or worsening abuse.

stories.headline: CAS Restores Senegal's AFCON 2025 Title
stories.summary: CAS overturned the CAF Appeal Board's 3-0 forfeit ruling. It held that the referee had authority to restart the final after Senegal's walk-off.

stories.headline: China names Pakistani astronaut to crew
stories.stat_label: foreign astronaut named to visit Tiangong
stories.summary: China named Pakistani payload specialist Muhammad Zeeshan Ali to Shenzhou-24 with commander Tang Hongbo and flight engineer Wu Yi.
